g.text: A dropped ACK delays its dependent work requests
Single GB200 · 4 simulated ranks · 3 queue pairs · task 009 v1
Each tick marks a sampled stage start on CTA 0, SM 148. Concurrent rows sharing a stage interval count once.
Lines span post to send completion. The independent 2 → 3 flow finishes before WR1 retransmits.
Source: task 009 v1 instrumented/stages.csv and ledger.csv · 116 transition rows, 97 distinct intervals, 15 ledger events
